usage: 腐皮卷 is a noun that refers to a specific dim sum dish made from tofu skin rolled around a filling.
You can use 腐皮卷 when ordering food at a dim sum restaurant or talking about different types of dim sum.
腐皮卷 can be a subject or object in a sentence, like ‘我鐘意食腐皮卷’ (I like to eat tofu skin roll).
When describing taste or ingredients, 腐皮卷 is usually combined with adjectives or fillers, e.g., ‘啲腐皮卷好好味’ (this tofu skin roll is very tasty).
You can also compare dishes using 腐皮卷, such as ‘腐皮卷比炸春卷健康啲’ (tofu skin roll is healthier than fried spring roll).
